text:
miguel: flagging a small UX regress: the scorecard compact rows hide the undo affordance for single-approve. seen in latest build. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-scorecard/x123
tara: saw it. compact mode removes inline undo to save space. tradeoff: discoverability vs density.
ben: propose: keep a 3s inline toast for single-approve with "Undo" button; longer bulk actions keep modal with explicit undo.
olivia: a11y: toast must be reachable by screen readers and keyboard. use `role=alert` and focusable Undo button. announce "Result approved. Undo available".
miguel: also copy tweak: current toast says "Saved" which is ambiguous. change to "Result approved". analytics wants verb `approve`.
tara: compactness nit: if we show inline toast, ensure it doesn't shift layout. absolute-positioned within result card works. keep 44px min touch target for Undo.
ben: UX question: should undo revert optimistic state or queue revert and reconcile server? prefer optimistic + background revert with conflict handling message.
olivia: screen reader flow: after undo, announce "Approval reverted". if conflict, announce "Could not revert: item updated on server" and show focusable `View changes` link.
ux-bot: accessibility-scan: recommended include `aria-live="polite"` region for toast and ensure color contrast for Undo button meets 3:1 on compact theme.
miguel: copy options for toast: A) "Result approved. Undo" B) "Approved — undo". which is clearer for quick scans?
tara: A reads clearer for screen readers. keep actual button text as `Undo` to save space. set aria-label `Undo approval for result <id>`.
ben: implementation note: keyboard shortcut `a` still approves; `u` right after approval could trigger undo if focus is on page. careful to avoid accidental undos. maybe limit keyboard-undo window to 5s.
olivia: recommend explicit keyboard flow: focus moves to toast Undo button when toast appears for 2s, then returns to prior focus. ensure focus restore works.
miguel: responsive: on very narrow viewports show toast full-width at bottom; on desktop attach to result card.
tara: i'll update figma with toast variants and label changes. ben can you sketch optimistic revert sequence in the PR description?
ben: will do. i'll add e2e tests: approve -> toast visible -> undo via button -> state reverted -> analytics event `approve.undo`.
ux-bot: accessibility-scan queued for branch. initial checks: toast region missing aria-live on prototype.
miguel: thanks all. i'll open PR with copy + positioning + a11y attributes and tag reviewers.
